notes.title: Early Access Expansion
notes.notes:
Were adding chapters 5, 6, and 7 in an early state.
The graphics are still every limited and their are some level balance issues.

However, we wanted to get it out so you all have more content to experience and we can get more feedback.

Additionally, we've rebalance much of the background and terrane to try to make it easier to read levels.

And Happy Holidays!

notes.title: November 20 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
 - Added an end level screen which will show your time and rank compared to a par time.
 - Added the ability to skip levels from the pause screen. (This is an early access only feature.)
 - Charge up tether points should now be easier to charge.
 - Charge up tether points now compute your momentum to their requirement differently, and hopefully more clearly.
 - Many levels have been reworked to be more challenging and engaging.
 - Completing a mural fragment will now instantly show its related lore and then restart the level.
 - Added additional tutorial text.

[b]Art[/b]
 - Kill on most levels should now be more tightly bound to terrane. (Visual only change.)
 - Terrane should now have a more vibrant look on all levels.
 - Tether jump and stored dash have a new indicator.
 - No-tether has a new visual that is hopefully more visible in most situations. (More work on this to come.)
 - Level end visuals have been expand to be more visible.
